title: Plaza Theatre (El Paso)
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap way supplies the bounded irregular theatre outline. USDA NAIP locates the large auditorium roof, elevated stage house and the entrance wing.
sectionBasis: The original Highsmith shot verifies the curved Spanish Colonial Revival gable, small round-arched balcony panel, relief sign, four pairs of doors and the geometric marquee. The theatre plan and technical records distinguish the auditorium from the adjacent mixed-use tower.
limitations: OpenStreetMap and the USDA orthophoto establish the extents. Main heights, the secondary roof equipment and rear opening details are estimated.
The marquee’s decorative pattern and lettering are model geometry. The message board is unlettered and the interior is outside the scope.
The connected Centre Building and adjacent Art Museum are separate structures.
